integrity: Complete proof, exact contact certificate, normalized references, and a runnable finite checker are included; mathematical and literature review is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Proved for odd n at least five and the standard Euclidean realization of the fractional stable-set polytope only; no even-cycle, integral stable-set or other-graph extension is claimed. Numerical validation is finite, while the infinite theorem follows analytically. Absolute literature priority is not independently established.
title: An exact John ellipsoid and sharp exponential law for odd-cycle fractional stable-set polytopes
